label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into an SQL query via concatenation (SQL Injection), despite an attempt to sanitize via list manipulation which does not protect against special characters used in SQL payloads. The ESAPI encoder is applied only in the error handling branch, not during query construction.

evidence.note: User parameter concatenated into SQL query without proper protection
Sanitization logic attempts to replace user input with hardcoded strings but fails to prevent SQL injection attacks
